name: What is the difference between a tenant improvement and a full commercial renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a tenant improvement and a full commercial renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tenant improvement usually adapts an existing space for a new occupant or use, while a full renovation may involve broader structural, systems, or layout changes. The more the work affects core building systems or occupancy, the more planning, permitting, and coordination it usually requires.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tenant improvements are usually space-specific build-outs, while full renovations can involve larger structural or systems changes. The bigger the scope, the more planning it needs.
